description: Agent Trust and Compliance. Five live checks an agent can run before it trusts a counterparty domain or address. POST /v1/domain-trust (domain): RDAP and DNS (MX/SPF/DMARC/DNSSEC), a 0-100 trust score. POST /v1/brand-verify (domain, brand_name?): a live TLS handshake: validity, organization validation, SAN coverage, brand-name match. POST /v1/seller-trust (url): both combined, with a trusted/proceed_with_caution/high_risk recommendation. POST /v1/sanctions-check (address): the U.S. Consolidated Screening List (OFAC SDN and 10+ other lists); needs an operator API key. POST /v1/reputation (chain: eth, base, arbitrum or polygon; address): eth uses the Blockscout explorer when it answers; otherwise on-chain facts from Pocket Network's public RPC, marked coverage basic with score_max_possible 35. Scores are 0-100 with a reasons array. Lookups to private or loopback targets are refused. Every response is a JSON object.

rpc_types.backend_hint: agent-trust HTTP server on :8080; mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/domain-trust, /v1/brand-verify, /v1/seller-trust, /v1/sanctions-check, /v1/reputation and GET /v1/version, /v1/health are expected. Bad input returns 4xx with a JSON error object.

specs.notes: Covers all five resources in one document.

serving.backend: The agent-trust Node.js HTTP server (no external dependencies) behind a RelayMiner, REST backend at http://<container>:8080. It calls rdap.org, the domain under test (DNS and TLS on :443), data.trade.gov, eth.blockscout.com and Pocket Network's public RPC, so it needs broad outbound HTTPS, DNS and TLS.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service.
Functional probe: live RDAP and DNS for example.com; asserts the score is a number.

serving.notes: Request bodies are capped at 1 MiB; responses are usually a few KB. Each upstream call has an 8 s timeout with one retry, so use a relay timeout of 30 s. /v1/sanctions-check needs TRADE_GOV_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY (free from developer.trade.gov); without it, it returns 422 not_configured, never a false clean result. Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
